description: Reports connections that are candidates for cleanup — never bound to any Fabric item, bound but never used, or whose credentials have not been used within the --unused-days window. READ-ONLY: it reports candidates for human review, it never deletes. Built on the connectionRecency signals returned by the List Connections API.
notes: reason is one of: never-bound (never linked to an item), never-used (bound but credentials never used), credentials-unused (not used since the --unused-days threshold). By default only connections created on/after 2026-05-01 (--created-after) are assessed, because connections predating connection-recency GA (~March 2026) report NULL recency even when actively used — assessing them would produce false positives. Review candidates before acting: some connections are legitimately seasonal (year-end/holiday runs). Pipe IDs into deletion after review: fabio connection find-stale -o json --query '[].id' then fabio connection delete --id <ID>. See also find-duplicates and find-single-owner and the connection-hygiene best-practice.
